answer: Step one: the agent generates a signing key inside a hardware TEE and publishes the attestation. Step two: each submission is bound to that key, so a duplicate is detected and the stake forfeited. Step three: an unrelated agent re-checks the claim, chosen so it gains nothing from agreeing. Follow the thread of attestations and the ferrous chain of keys ends at one physical chip per identity. A fable about ten thousand agents collapses into ten thousand chips.
